messages.author: apoc
messages.content_text: Breakeven of doom and despair. 9:30 open swept out the internal high that I had my BE level at and began dumping so to follow my rules I moved myself break even, if I had kept the original stop this was a 1:4.6RR bottom tick. But Id rather follow my rules than break them and gain profit from those actions thereby reinforcing them. This trade was taken off of a sweep of liquidity creating a 3m bearish rejection block after sweeping buyside liquidity and a strong close in the opposite direction, thereby validating that rejection block as a valid level. Took my entry on the beginning of the level, was targeting a minimum of a retrace to the .62 on the fib before potentially continuing lower. The plan for my tp was to take 2 of the 3 micros off at the .62 level around 685 then let the last one either run to the high or back to my breakeven. Unfortunately while all the fundamentals for the trade were extremely solid and spot on, market open isn't a beast I like to play with when I have wider stops.
